target: Locate a failure and test a causal remedy for forgetting policies using a retention-and-deletion policy. Use a provenance-checked real dataset with consent and access rules.

competency.title: Diagnose forgetting policies — field data
competency.outcome: Locate a failure and test a causal remedy for forgetting policies using a retention-and-deletion policy. Use a provenance-checked real dataset with consent and access rules.

topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: keeping sensitive data in derived caches

competency.practice_task: Produce a fault trace, hypothesis table and controlled repair grounded in a retention-and-deletion policy.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a provenance-checked real dataset with consent and access rules.
required_evidence: a fault trace, hypothesis table and controlled repair
Include the data card, missingness check and permitted use.
Report correct deletion and downstream purge with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: keeping sensitive data in derived caches.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of forgetting policies.
Practice: the repair fixes the target without hiding a regression.
Measurement: report correct deletion and downstream purge against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for keeping sensitive data in derived caches; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
